name: Ino Ossan to Necafe de Hitoban
original_name: 猪おっさんとネカフェで一晩
source:
Missed the last train? You find yourself spending the night at a cramped net cafe. By a strange twist of fate, you end up sharing a private room with a middle-aged wild boar salaryman...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ01569543.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
错过了末班车？你发现自己在一家狭窄的网吧过夜。机缘巧合，你和一个中年野猪工薪族同住一间私人房间……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/bl/work/=/product_id/RJ01569543.html]DLsite[/url]]
